# Error #83: NoPendingRateChange

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#83`
- **Variant Name**: `NoPendingRateChange`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `WARNING`
- **Retryable**: `Yes`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::NoPendingRateChange` — no rate-change proposal is stored for the stream.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::rate_proposal_follows_the_two_step_window`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::rate_proposal_follows_the_two_step_window). // NoPendingRateChange — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Call `propose_rate_change` and let the counterparty accept it before accepting or cancelling; check the pending rate proposal first.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#18-two-step-rate-renegotiation`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#18-two-step-rate-renegotiation)
